info.title: ASA Server Manager API
info.description: REST API for managing ARK: Survival Ascended Server instances

get.summary: List all instances with basic configuration
get.description: Returns a list of all server instances including their running status, ASA version, status history and configuration information

delete.description: Stops the instance if running, then removes its directory and save data.

put.description: Stops the instance if running, renames its directory and save data, and updates SaveDir in the new instance's configuration.

get.description: Returns mod information extracted from server logs (mod ID and name mappings), read from mod_info.json in BaseDir.

Atomically transitions the instance state to start_initialization and starts the server asynchronously. Fails fast with 409 if port conflicts exist or the instance is not in a startable state (stopped/start_failed/stop_failed/restart_failed/unset).

409.description: Port conflict, or instance not in a startable state

get.description: Optionally announces an in-game countdown before stopping (see query params). Atomically transitions state from started to stopping; returns 409 if the instance is not currently started.

200.description: Server is stopping (asynchronous; countdown runs first if requested)

get.description: Optionally announces an in-game countdown before restarting (see query params). Atomically transitions state from started to restarting; returns 409 if the instance is not currently started.

200.description: Server is restarting (asynchronous; countdown runs first if requested)

get.description: Kills the instance process tree immediately, bypassing RCON saveworld/graceful shutdown and any in-progress countdown.

get.summary: Get the active stop/restart countdown for an instance

200.description: Countdown status (active: false if none in progress)

post.description: Cancels the in-progress stop/restart countdown for this instance and rolls its state back to started. Only affects this one instance, even if it's part of a batch operation.

404.description: No active countdown for this instance

get.summary: Update ARK server with real-time progress
get.description: Downloads and updates the ARK server files using SteamCMD. Returns a Server-Sent Events stream with real-time progress. Reconnecting clients replay history and subscribe; only one update runs globally at a time (Start() elects a single winner).

200.description: SSE stream with update progress messages

get.summary: Get whether a server update is currently running

get.description: Returns an SSE stream with system CPU and memory usage, updated every 2 seconds.

200.description: SSE stream with resource information every 2s

get.summary: Stream resource information for all running instances
get.description: Returns an SSE stream with CPU/memory usage per running instance plus overall system totals, sent immediately on connect and then every 2 seconds.

200.description: SSE stream of all-instances resource info

get.summary: Resource sampling history for trend charts
get.description: Returns up to 30 minutes of columnar resource samples so a freshly mounted chart is not empty. Held in an in-memory ring buffer and flushed to Badger every 5 minutes, so it survives a restart.

parameters.name: window
parameters.description: Window length in seconds, default 900, capped at 1800

parameters.name: instance
parameters.description: Instance name. Omit to get host columns only

post.description: Starts a batch operation across the given instances, staggered by delay_seconds between each. An optional countdown announces the operation in-game beforehand. Only one batch operation can run at a time.

200.description: Batch operation accepted (returns pre-flight eligible/skipped instances)

400.description: No instances to operate on, or invalid countdown parameters

409.description: A batch operation is already running

400.description: No instances to operate on, or invalid countdown parameters

409.description: A batch operation is already running

400.description: No instances to operate on, or invalid countdown parameters

409.description: A batch operation is already running

get.summary: Get the current batch operation status

200.description: Batch status (active: false if none running)

get.summary: Stream batch operation logs via SSE
get.description: Replays log history for the current (or most recently finished) batch operation, then streams new entries in real time while a batch is running. If the last operation has already finished, only the replay is sent.

200.description: SSE stream of batch log entries

post.description: Cancels the batch operation as a whole. Instances not yet started are marked cancelled; the instance currently in flight is allowed to finish. To exclude a single instance from an in-progress batch instead, use /api/server/batch/skip.

404.description: No active batch operation to cancel

post.summary: Skip a single instance within the running batch operation
post.description: Marks one instance to be skipped once the batch's main loop reaches it (status transitions pending -> skip_requested -> skipped). Broadcasts the skip to other connected clients.

400.description: instance_name missing, or instance cannot be skipped in its current state

500.description: Server error (instance not running, RCON connection failed, etc.)

post.summary: Create a world-save backup of an instance

get.summary: List world-save backups for an instance

post.summary: Restore a world-save backup to an instance
post.description: Restores the worldfile (SaveDir content) from a backup file to a server instance. Before restoring, a best-effort snapshot of the current state is saved as a 'latest' backup.

restore_worldfile.summary: Restore worldfile (filename relative to the instance's backup directory)

get.description: Retrieves both Game.ini and GameUserSettings.ini from the base server directory (ShooterGame/Saved/Config/WindowsServer).

404.description: Both configuration files not found in server base directory

get.description: Retrieves both Game.ini and GameUserSettings.ini for a specific instance.

404.description: Both configuration files not found for instance

400.description: No file provided, or file exceeds 10MB

put.summary: Update Game.ini content directly via text

400.description: No file provided, or file exceeds 10MB

put.summary: Update GameUserSettings.ini content directly via text

post.summary: Sync instance configuration and Config folder from source to multiple target instances
post.description: Synchronizes instance configuration fields (ModIDs, ServerPassword, ServerAdminPassword and, by default, CustomStartParameters/EnableAsaPlugin) and the entire Config folder from a source instance to multiple target instances. Target instances keep their other configuration fields (ServerName, Port, RCONPort, MaxPlayers, MapName, SaveDir, ClusterID) intact.

200.description: Instance configuration synced successfully to all targets

500.description: One or more targets failed to sync (partial or full failure)

get.description: Returns the player list. Prefers arkmonitor's in-memory cache for the instance; falls back to a synchronous save-file parse if no cached snapshot is available.
Returns the tribe list. Prefers arkmonitor's in-memory cache for the instance; falls back to a synchronous save-file parse if no cached snapshot is available.

get.summary: Stream game server log for an instance
get.description: Tails the instance's server.log via SSE, sending the last 200 lines first, then new lines as they arrive.

get.summary: Stream AsaApiLoader console output for an instance
get.description: Tails the AsaApiLoader PTY console log captured when the instance is started in plugin mode. The file is truncated and re-created each time the instance is started in plugin mode. Works even if the instance has never been started in plugin mode (the log helper creates an empty file).

200.description: SSE stream of AsaApiLoader console output

get.summary: Stream the application's own system log
get.description: Tails asaServer.log via SSE, sending the last 500 lines first.

200.description: SSE stream of system log lines

get.description: Returns the 256px PNG icon for a creature by its raw display name. The name is normalized (special characters replaced with `_`, consecutive underscores merged, leading/trailing underscores trimmed) before looking up the embedded icon file.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Raw creature display name, e.g. `Alpha T-Rex`, `Dinopithecus King (Gamma)`

404.description: Icon not found for the given name

get.description: Returns the 256px PNG icon for an item by its raw display name. The name is normalized the same way as the creature icon endpoint.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Raw item display name, e.g. `Absorbent Substrate`

404.description: Icon not found for the given name

400.description: Validation failed (bad rule/time, unknown instance, etc.)
Validation failed, or task not found

post.summary: Enable or disable a scheduled task

post.description: Triggers one immediate execution without affecting the task's NextRunAt. Runs in the background; the request returns right away.

get.description: Returns run records newest-first, optionally filtered to a single task. `total` is the count after filtering but before the limit is applied, for displaying 'N total' in the UI.

parameters.name: task_id
parameters.description: Filter to a single task's run history

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Max records to return (default 100, capped at the 500-record storage limit)

total.description: Total matching records before the limit was applied

delete.summary: Clear all scheduled task execution logs

get.summary: WebSocket connection for real-time server events
get.description: Establishes a WebSocket connection to receive real-time broadcast events for all server instances, including batch operation progress. Client should send a ClientMessage with client_id on connection. All connected clients receive the same events globally.

get.summary: WebSocket connection for RCON command execution
get.description: Establishes a WebSocket connection for interactive RCON command execution. Each command is executed independently with a temporary RCON connection to the specified instance. No persistent connection state is maintained.

101.description: Switching Protocols - WebSocket connection established for RCON commands

get.summary: Stream FRP client status changes via SSE
get.description: Real-time stream of FRP status changes; checks once per second and only sends an event when the status changes.

200.description: SSE stream of FRP status events

get.description: Returns config.xml content. If the file doesn't exist yet (Syncthing never started), returns an empty XML template with success: true rather than an error.

200.description: Syncthing config (or empty template) retrieved successfully

put.description: Overwrites config.xml. If Syncthing is currently running, it is automatically restarted to pick up the new config.

400.description: Invalid request, or config.xml does not exist yet (start Syncthing first)

500.description: Config updated but restart failed, or other server error

get.summary: Stream Syncthing status changes via SSE
get.description: Polls status once per second and streams every reading (unlike the FRP equivalent, which only sends changes).

200.description: SSE stream of Syncthing status events

CountdownParam.name: countdown
CountdownParam.description: Total countdown seconds before the action runs (30-86400). Omit or 0 to act immediately.

NotifyPointsParam.name: notify_points
NotifyPointsParam.description: Comma-separated seconds-remaining values at which an in-game announcement fires, e.g. `600,300,60,30,10`. Each must be <= countdown. Defaults to a built-in preset if omitted.

NotifyMessageParam.name: notify_message
NotifyMessageParam.description: Announcement template. Supports {time}, {action}, {instance} placeholders. Defaults to '服务器将在 {time} 后{action}，请及时下线'.

NotifyCommandParam.name: notify_command
NotifyCommandParam.description: RCON command used to deliver the announcement. Defaults to ServerChat.

running.description: Whether the server instance is currently running

status.description: Current status of the instance (see InstanceState.status enum)

status_history.description: History of instance status changes (up to 200 most recent entries)

asaVersion.description: Detected ASA server build/version, if available

backup_file.description: File name of the backup, resolved within instances/{name}/backup/. Restoring always replaces the worldfile (SaveDir content) only.

MapName.description: Name of the map to use

EnableAsaPlugin.description: Whether ASA plugins (AsaApiLoader.exe) are enabled for the server

BindDomain.description: Domain resolved to an IP and used for server binding/advertising

MessageOfTheDay.description: Message of the day shown to connecting players

MessageOfTheDayDuration.description: Duration in seconds the message of the day is displayed

UpdateInstanceConfigRequest.description: Partial instance configuration update request; omitted fields are left unchanged

SyncInstanceConfigRequest.description: Request to sync instance configuration and files from a source instance to multiple target instances

source_instance.description: Name of the source instance to sync from

target_instances.description: List of target instance names to sync to

sync_custom_start_parameters.description: Whether to also sync CustomStartParameters. Defaults to true.

sync_enable_asa_plugin.description: Whether to also sync EnableAsaPlugin. Defaults to true.

only_sync_server_game_ini_config.description: When true, only sync the Config folder's Game.ini/GameUserSettings.ini and skip instance_config.ini fields entirely.

synced_instances.description: List of successfully synced target instances

failed_instances.description: List of instances that failed to sync with error details (present only when at least one target failed)

count.description: Total number of successfully synced instances

delay_seconds.description: Delay between starting each instance's operation, to avoid saturating the host

countdown.description: Countdown seconds announced in-game before the batch operation begins, 0 = immediate

notify_points.description: Seconds-remaining values at which an announcement fires

ScheduleTask.description: A scheduled task definition, as persisted in schedules.json

type.description: update stops all instances first (installer requires no live instances), restart is a plain batch restart

every.description: Used by interval_hours/interval_days; ignored by daily

at.description: "HH:mm" time of day; ignored by interval_hours

instances.description: Only used by restart tasks; empty means all instances

countdown.description: Countdown seconds before execution, 0 = no countdown

ScheduleTaskRequest.description: Request body to create/update a task. Server-managed fields (id, last_run_at, next_run_at) cannot be set by the client.

ScheduleRunRecord.description: Archive of one task execution. Deliberately not step-by-step: batch/update SSE streams already cover live progress.

task_id.description: Kept even if the task is later deleted, so history stays readable

trigger.description: schedule = fired automatically; manual = triggered via the run-now endpoint

message.description: Summary on success, failure reason on failure

ClientMessage.description: Message sent from WebSocket client to server (for heartbeat, connection identification, etc.)

client_id.description: Unique client identifier provided by the client

ServerUpdateSSEStream.description: SSE stream for real-time server update progress

data.description: Progress message from the update process

update_ark_server.value: data: Downloading and updating ARK server files...

error.value: data: Error: Failed to download SteamCMD: network error

ServerInfoSSEStream.description: SSE stream for real-time system resource information (updated every 2s)

error.value: data: {"error":"Failed to get memory info: connection error"}

MetricsHistoryResponse.description: Columnar resource sample history. The backend keeps 30 minutes; charts use it to backfill on mount

timestamps.description: Unix seconds (with a fractional part), strictly increasing

host.description: Keys: cpu_used_percent, mem_used_percent, disk_read_bytes_per_sec, disk_write_bytes_per_sec, disk_read_iops, disk_write_iops, net_recv_bytes_per_sec, net_sent_bytes_per_sec

additionalProperties.description: null marks a point that could not be sampled

instance.description: Only present when the instance query parameter was given. Keys: cpu_percent, cpu_total_percent, memory_percent, memory_used, disk_*, net_*

additionalProperties.description: null marks a point that could not be sampled

AllInstancesInfoSSEStream.description: SSE stream for all running instances' resource information, sent immediately on connect and then every 2s

host.description: Host-wide metrics, the data source for the server-level trend charts

disk_io.description: Sum over whole disks only (Linux excludes partitions/dm-*/loop*; on Windows gopsutil already returns fixed volumes)

net_io.description: Sum over physical NICs (loopback and virtual interfaces excluded)

memory.description: Legacy field kept for the existing progress-bar components; new code reads host.memory

cpu_percent.description: single-core 100% scale, can exceed 100 on multi-core

cpu_total_percent.description: instance CPU% normalized by core count

disk_io.description: Per-process I/O rates (on Windows this counts all I/O, not just physical disk). Null as a whole when unavailable

net_io.description: Per-process network rates. Always null on Windows; on Linux only when the eBPF probe is available

ServerEvent.description: Server event message sent via WebSocket (global broadcast to all connected clients)

instance_name.description: Name of the server instance that triggered the event (empty for connection/global events)

RCONMessage.description: Message sent from WebSocket client to server for RCON operations

instance_name.description: Name of the instance (required for command action)

command.description: RCON command to execute (required for command action)

RCONResponseData.description: Response from RCON operations over WebSocket

response.description: RCON command execution response (for command action)

ManagedServiceStatusResponse.description: Generic response shape shared by the FRP and Syncthing management endpoints

PlayerListItem.description: Player entry as returned by the save-data endpoints (shape depends on go-arkparser/arkmonitor export; treat as a loosely-typed map)

TribeListItem.description: Tribe entry as returned by the save-data endpoints (shape depends on go-arkparser/arkmonitor export; treat as a loosely-typed map)
